summary: T1 Energy Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the purchase of all intellectual property and related assets from Singapore-based Evervolt Green Energy Holding Pte, Ltd. for $133 million, plus a $2 million option premium previously paid. The purchase price is payable in four tranches through October 2026, each at T1's election in cash, common stock, or a combination; the first tranche ($60M) is intended to be paid in stock. The acquisition follows exercise of a call option and terminates existing IP licenses. The parties made customary representations and warranties, including seller's ownership and title.
